https://formspec.cloud/app.title: Formspec Cloud
https://formspec.cloud/app.description: Customer workspace and public response routes rendered entirely from Formspec documents.

binding.content: LIVE — Sign in, recover access, and confirm the active customer workspace before opening account data.

config.title: Account access
config.body: Use account access to enter or recover the intended workspace.
config.emptyMessage: No additional information is available for this view.

binding.content: LIVE — Open published forms, review responses, check signature work, manage integrations and organization settings, and compare plan usage.

config.title: Dashboard
config.body: Choose the work you need to continue.
config.emptyMessage: No additional information is available for this view.

binding.content: LIVE — Create the organization, name the first workspace, and choose the first environment without staff editing tenant records.

config.title: Set up organization
config.body: Complete the organization fields, then finish setup.
config.emptyMessage: No additional information is available for this view.

binding.content: LIVE — Find draft and published forms, identify the version people will complete, and open a form for sharing or preview.

config.title: Forms
config.body: Open a form to inspect its hosted version and sharing path.
config.emptyMessage: No additional information is available for this view.

params.name: formId
params.description: Tenant-scoped draft or published form identifier supplied by the host.

binding.content: LIVE — Inspect the selected form identifier, hosted address, current version, sharing state, and response access.

config.title: Form detail
config.body: The route parameter identifies the tenant form currently in view.
config.emptyMessage: No additional information is available for this view.

binding.content: PREVIEW — Check the hosted form flow before publishing or sharing its stable address.

config.title: Hosted form preview
config.body: Review the hosted experience, then return to the selected form.
config.emptyMessage: No additional information is available for this view.

binding.content: LIVE — Review recent responses, identify their state, see proof status, and find the available export formats.

config.title: Responses and exports
config.body: Response data comes from the host-owned tenant query.
config.emptyMessage: No responses are available for this profile.

binding.content: LIVE — Follow a basic signature request through completion and retrieve its certificate. Enhanced identity proofing remains unavailable.

config.title: Signature workflows
config.body: Track the current signature work and return to response operations.
config.emptyMessage: No additional information is available for this view.

binding.content: LIVE — Create an API key, use generated API documentation, make a sandbox request, and inspect one webhook delivery.

config.title: API and webhooks
config.body: Connect a customer system and review the usage that integration work consumes.
config.emptyMessage: No additional information is available for this view.

binding.content: LIVE — Review organization, workspace, environment, teammate, and role setup. Assisted capabilities show their request state.

config.title: Organization administration
config.body: Review the organization setup or return to edit its core fields.
config.emptyMessage: No additional information is available for this view.

binding.content: LIVE — Compare response usage with the plan limit and check plan and billing state.

config.title: Usage and billing
config.body: Billing data is supplied by the host for the active customer workspace.
config.emptyMessage: Plan and usage data are unavailable.

binding.content: LIVE — Distinguish service states, review incident availability, reach support, and find current trust documents.

config.title: Support, status, and trust
config.body: Trust data is a host-provided document resource.
config.emptyMessage: Support and trust data are unavailable.

binding.content: LIVE — Enter the requested information, review it, and submit it to the organization.
LIVE — Keep the receipt and its proof state as evidence that the organization received the response.

config.title: Submission receipt
config.body: Retain this receipt or open support when its proof needs attention.
config.emptyMessage: No additional information is available for this view.
